implementation_summary: Added specs/buck2-cargo-target-coverage.json to define AC-0.13 target-root coverage measurement between Cargo workspace lib/bin targets and checked-in Buck2 rust crate_root mappings.

Added scripts/ci/assert-buck2-cargo-target-coverage.py to parse Cargo.toml workspace members (including glob/exclude expansion), discover Cargo lib/bin target roots including autolib/autobins-aware src/lib.rs, src/main.rs, src/bin/*.rs, and src/bin/*/main.rs roots, scan BUCK crate_root mappings (including parent BUCK files such as tools/oci/BUCK), and fail on missing/unregistered/stale divergences while keeping live-readiness claims false.

Added scripts/tests/buck2_cargo_target_coverage_check.test.sh with GOOD current-workspace, BAD missing-BUCK fixture, GOOD parent-BUCK fixture, GOOD autobins=false fixture, and BAD p0_0_green mutation coverage.

Added //:buck2-cargo-target-coverage-check with repo_relative_root=true, remote=false, cacheable=false because the scanner spans Buck package boundaries; wired it into the Buck2 authority policy and AC-0.16 automation matrix/coverage registry.
known_gaps: This is target-root mapping coverage, not source-line coverage.
The Buck2 target runs repo_relative_root=true/cacheable=false/remote=false for whole-repo package-boundary scanning; this is local/static evidence and not hermetic remote-execution proof.
No live cloud-ci/oya-ci required context ran this target on the candidate SHA.
